description: Sittings of work by a person or an agent — who, when, how long, what came out — saved from the transcript, analysed and bound to records.

dreamteamer.title: Sessions
dreamteamer.description: `sessions`: one sitting of work — an agent session, an agent run, a person's focused block — with who, when, how long, what it cost and what came out. /session:save reads the metrics from the transcript, /session:analyze writes the critique, `dt session bind` names the records a session worked on and `dt next` lists them. Draws `agents` in the nav. Depends on `users`; peers `projects`, `tasks`.
